conflict_rule: A source satisfying both cohort definitions is excluded. No such source was found in the source-only schema audit.
noncohort_rule: Rows satisfying neither frozen bound are excluded from inference; their fallback reporting age cannot create cohort membership.
scientific_rationale: The released VAC provides gyro-interp in its young calibrated regime and GPgyro in its old-star regime. Both cohorts remain exact-ID subsets of the same official VAC; methods are not mixed within a cohort.
outcome_guardrail: This adapter was fixed from column names, documented estimator validity ranges, age bounds, and position/count support only. No Gaia velocity component or young-old current contrast was evaluated.
